definitions.explanation: A temporary interruption or gap in something continuous. Most commonly used in the negative form 絶え間なく (without pause, incessantly).

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{絶|た}え{間|ま}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The construction noise continues without a break.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}びら→花びら：13988_hanabira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{絶|た}え{間|ま}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{散|ち}り→散る：02075_chiru⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧⟦ピンク→ピンク：04718_pinku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絨毯|じゅうたん}→絨毯：04497_juutan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ようだった。
examples.english: Cherry blossom petals kept falling without pause, and the path looked like a pink carpet.

notes:
The noun {絶|た}え{間|ま} means a pause or break in something continuous, but it is most commonly used in the adverbial form {絶|た}え{間|ま}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without pause, ceaselessly). In fact, {絶|た}え{間|ま}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ is far more common than the bare noun.

USAGE:
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ (ceaselessly, without interruption) is the standard usage
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (unceasing, constant) is the adjective form
- Emphasizes that something continues without any break or pause

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to continue without pause
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧: unceasing effort
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧: to flow without stopping
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧: incessant noise

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: without rest — simpler and more casual
- ⟦ひっきりなしに→ひっきりなしに：20411_hikkirinashini⟧: incessantly — emphasizes frequency of repeated events
- {間断|かんだん}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: without interruption — more formal/literary
- ⟦{途切|とぎ}れなく→途切れる：18055_togireru⟧: without breaking off — emphasizes continuity
